items.title: The Procession and Commencement
notes: A special meeting of City Council for its inaugural meeting was held at 7:30 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

items.title: The Singing of our National Anthem
notes: The meeting began with the singing of “O Canada” by KW Glee.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement and Indigenous Reflection
notes: The Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor. Clarence Cachagee, who comes from the people of the Mushkegowuk, provided an Indigenous Reflection.

items.title: Invocations
notes: The Mayor called upon Swami Chaitanya Jyoti Ji Maharaj or commonly known as DiDiJi, Head Preacher of the Bramarishi Mission of Canada and Father Myroslaw Tataryn, Pastor, Ukrainian Catholic Church of the Transfiguration to provide invocations.

items.title: The Mayor and Council’s Declaration of Office
notes: Honourable Madam Justice Jennifer Breithaupt Smith presided to complete the Declarations of Elected Office of the Mayor and Members of Council.

items.title: Reflection
notes: The Mayor welcome Father Toby Collins, Pastor, St. Mary’s Parish to provide a moment of reflection.

items.title: Musical Interlude
notes: Wilfrid Laurier University’s Beckett School at Laurier, played a musical interlude.
